items.title: Rossano Sportiello interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 2, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Rossano was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on October 2, 2015 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Rossano was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on October 2, 2015 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are actually in the Hampton Inn in New Hartford. I have Rossano Sportiello with me today on the occasion of Fallcoming Jazz 2015 at Hamilton College. Thanks for spending time with me.
It’s a pleasure and as we say in Italy, buongiorno.
